items.title: India buys its most expensive LNG in years as war upends market
items.description: State-backed energy companies in India are turning to the LNG spot market and bidding up prices as the government is pushing to support fertilizer producers, which use natural gas.

items.title: Why Bengaluru airport’s new arrival fee may not make your flight more expensive
items.description: Bengaluru’s revised airport tariff structure lowers the UDF for departing passengers while introducing a charge for arrivals, reducing the overall burden for round-trip travellers

items.title: Beyond 800 locomotives: Alstom sees bigger role for Madhepura in Indian Railways’ journey
items.description: The company’s initial order of 800 electric freight locomotives is scheduled for completion by March 2028. In 2015, Indian Railways and Alstom had set up a joint venture, Madhepura Electric Locomotive Private Limited (MELPL), to manufacture the locomotives.

items.title: Walmart expects over 100-bps hit in Q3 sales from Flipkart shifting of Big Billion Days sales
items.description: The company further said e-commerce growth in its international segment rose 19 per cent, led by China, India and Canada.

items.title: MMDR Act 2026 to address long-standing operational bottlenecks in mining sector: NMDC chief
items.description: The amendments made by the government will address long-standing operational bottlenecks in the mining sector by bringing greater uniformity and predictability, said NMDC CMD Amitava Mukherjee.

items.title: LG Electronics India: Screen space is getting bigger
items.description: Premium products, rising exports, and the Sri City ramp-up could add a new leg to growth
